meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

copy.tagline: 将上游更新选择性合并到本地定制版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护了上游项目的定制分支，需要定期合并更新
copy.tagline_en: Selectively merge upstream updates into your customized fork
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized fork of an upstream project and need to regularly merge updates

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 帮你把上游 NanoClaw 的更新合并到你自定义的安装中，同时保留你的修改。它会先备份、预览变更，然后让你选择合并、挑选提交或变基，最后验证构建和测试。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 命令时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw 检查上游更新。
say.note: 技能会开始预检并显示变更预览。

say.text: 用 /update-nanoclaw 合并最新的上游提交。
say.note: 技能会执行合并并处理冲突。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you merge upstream NanoClaw updates into your customized install while preserving your modifications. It creates a backup, previews changes, then lets you choose merge, cherry-pick, or rebase, followed by validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run `/update-nanoclaw` in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to check for upstream updates.
say_en.note: Skill starts preflight and shows change preview.

say_en.text: Use /update-nanoclaw to merge the latest upstream commits.
say_en.note: Skill performs merge and resolves conflicts.
Skill lets you select commits to apply.
